releaseNotes:
• 📋 Activity Tab & Audit Log: Track account add/edit/delete, balance adjustments, deleted transactions, and notification/schedule switches in one place
• ⚖️ Accurate Historical Balances: Updating current balance in Manage Accounts now keeps older transaction closing balances untouched by default
• 🔄 Complete Transfer & Timeline Accuracy: Incoming Bank/Cash transfers and mixed date formats always stay in exact chronological balance order
• 🧹 Clear Activity Controls: Filter by category or account and clear older or filtered activity logs anytime
